title: Pacman City: Turning "Dodge the Ghosts" into Timed Route Planning
subtitle: 120 seconds, 3 lives, 323 dots: eat and dodge through a block-city maze, where the 8-second power-pellet reversal is the only rhythm switch that matters.

cover.alt: Pacman City: Turning "Dodge the Ghosts" into Timed Route Planning

coverWide.alt: Pacman City: Turning "Dodge the Ghosts" into Timed Route Planning

corePoints: A hard 120-second countdown: scoring and survival are mutually exclusive at every moment
The 8-second power window is the game's only attack/defense reversal switch
Score gradient 10/50/200 keeps reward strictly aligned with risk
4 ghosts plus 3 lives: beginners survive, veterans feel the squeeze

breakdown.title: Rule Skeleton
bullets: 120-second countdown plus 3 lives; time out or losing all lives triggers game.over
Dot = +10; power pellet = +50 and an 8-second power mode; eating a ghost during power mode = +200
Colliding with a ghost in normal mode calls handlePlayerDeath and costs one life; clearing all dots advances to the next level

breakdown.title: Behavior Loop
bullets: Read the maze and ghost positions → plan an eating route → steer with arrow keys or the joystick → score dots
Eat a power pellet → 8 seconds of role reversal → chase ghosts for big points → back to dodging when it ends
Time out / out of lives → result screen → restart (full reset) or back to menu

breakdown.title: Implementation Notes
bullets: Gameplay data and rules live on the v2-kernel state machine (boot/menu/gameplay/result) with event-driven transitions
core/pacman-city owns the maze, dots, ghost AI and collision detection; the rule layer only reads and writes data
The scene-private renderer __OV.Games.PacmanCity.Game handles PIXI drawing plus joystick/keyboard input
